The '''rebel refugee zone''' was the name given to part of the [[Duros slums]] in the [[Duros Sector]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The zone was home to a number of anti-Imperial rebels who were supported by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rebel refugee zone appears as a Heroic area in the Duros Sector in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
